'''Marpessa Munitions''' was an arms [[Factory/Legends|factory]] located in [[Gunrunner Circle]] in the [[Red Light Sector (Nar Shaddaa)|Red Light Sector]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. It was abandoned by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], when defectors from the [[Republic Special Forces Division]] began using it as a base. [[Havoc Squad]] attacked the factory to trigger its alarms and allow the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] to trace their signal.<ref name="TOR" />
